At Corsearch, we are dedicated to creating a world where consumers can trust the choices they make.
As a global leader in Trademark and Brand Protection, we partner with businesses to safeguard their most valuable assets in an increasingly complex digital environment.
Our comprehensive solutions, powered by AI-driven data and deep analytics, enable brands to establish, monitor, and protect their presence against infringement and counterfeiting.
 Why Choose Corsearch?
Innovative Solutions: We combine cutting-edge technology with expert judgment to deliver market-leading services in trademark clearance, brand protection, and anti-counterfeiting.
Global Impact: Trusted by over 5,000 customers worldwide, including 73 of Fortune's Top 100 companies, our work has a meaningful impact on businesses and consumers alike.
Collaborative Culture: With a team of over 1,900 professionals across multiple global offices, you'll be joining an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives thrive.
Mission-Driven Purpose: Our commitment to protecting consumers and their trust in brands drives everything we do, making Corsearch a force for good in the world.
 ✅The Role
 We are looking for a Staff Frontend Engineer to own the frontend of our brand-protection platform. This is a senior individual-contributor role with real technical authority: you set the frontend architecture and standards, have the final say in code review, and mentor the engineers around you. There are no direct reports. Engineering management sits with our backend lead, so your time goes into the codebase and the people building it with you. You report to the Head of Product Engineering.
 What You'll Own
The frontend codebase, end to end. A mature TypeScript monorepo powering a product customers rely on every day: the main React app, our design system, a typed API layer generated from the backend's OpenAPI spec, the Express server in front of the app, and the CI/CD pipeline that ships it. You decide where it goes next and keep it on a modern, well-chosen stack.
Quality and performance. Bundle size, rendering performance on data-heavy views, observability, and a testing strategy spanning unit, end-to-end and visual regression tests.
The design system. A shared component library built on Tailwind, shadcn/ui and Radix, documented in Storybook, with design rules enforced by lint.
 Example projects
An app-wide redesign. The whole product is moving to a new design language, page by page, while it stays live for customers.
Advanced Filters. A visual query builder with nested condition groups and type-aware operators across dozens of filters, used by analysts every day.
Ask Cortex. An AI chat that answers questions about a brand's data, with streamed responses and report generation.
Video Protection. Bringing video into moderation: frame-accurate screenshots, transcripts with keyword search, and evidence capture.
 Beyond these, the product covers enforcement workflows (takedown notices, automated rules, search-engine delisting), client-facing dashboards and reporting.
 Why it's interesting
Real ownership. You are the person who decides how a large, live product's frontend is built, not one voice among many.
Hard UI problems. Complex filtering, large virtualised tables, dense dashboards and media review tools for people who use them all day.
AI in the product. LLM-powered features such as streaming chat and generated reports are shipping now, not on a slide.
AI in how we work. The team develops with AI coding agents every day, with shared skills, hooks and agent guidelines in the repo. You will shape how that works.
Work that matters. What you build helps brands take down counterfeits, piracy and fraud at scale.
 The team
 You will join five frontend engineers embedded in product squads, working closely with backend engineers, product managers and designers.
 Tech stack
Core: React 19, TypeScript, Bun
UI: Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui, Radix UI, Storybook, Chromatic
Data, forms and display: TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Zod, TanStack Table, TanStack Virtual, Recharts, Redux
Routing and server: React Router 7, Express
Testing: Playwright, Testing Library
Observability: Sentry, OpenTelemetry
Delivery: GitHub Actions, AWS
 ✅Responsibilities and Duties
Around 8+ years building frontends, with staff-level scope in a recent role.
Deep expertise in React and TypeScript.
Ownership of a large single-page application end to end: architecture, tooling, build and deploy.
A track record of leading large, incremental migrations without stopping feature delivery.
Strong judgement on data-layer and state design in complex applications.
Experience building or running a design system.
A rigorous approach to performance and observability (bundle analysis, Sentry, OpenTelemetry or similar).
A clear testing strategy across unit, end-to-end and visual tests.
Daily, opinionated use of AI coding agents, and interest in making a team effective with them.
You keep up with the frontend ecosystem and make sound calls on what to adopt and what to skip.
You lead through code review, written proposals and mentoring rather than through a management title.
Fluent written and spoken English.
